DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの資料で、どの点を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to check in the documents you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約の確認と支払の控えで年が違います。どちらの日付を説明すべきか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約と支払で年が異なる資料の日付を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The reservation confirmation and the payment receipt show different years. I'm unsure which date I should explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the dates on reservation and payment documents showing different years. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 資料の種類と、実際に行ったことを分けてお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please explain the types of documents separately from what you actually did.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 年末に予約し、翌年に支払いました。予約しただけの日を支払日として書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約年と翌年の支払を区別し記入の誤りを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I made the reservation at the end of the year and paid the following year. I mistakenly wrote the day I only made the reservation as the payment date.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the reservation year from payment the following year and explain the mistake in your entry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 税の扱いは内容を確認してからのご案内です。まず日付の事実を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can advise on the tax treatment after checking the details. First, let's organize the facts about the dates.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 支払った日は控えで確かめられます。予約日は別の紙から確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 控えと予約紙からそれぞれの日付を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can verify the day I paid from the receipt. I'll check the reservation date on the other sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check each date using the payment receipt and reservation document. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 両方の資料を残してください。費用の内容も担当へ説明していただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep both documents. You'll also need to explain what the expense was for to the person handling your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 控えだけで扱いが決まるとは考えず、何の費用かも説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 費用の内容も伝え税の扱いを自己判断しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't assume the receipt alone determines how it's treated. I'll also explain what the expense was for.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the nature of the expense and will not decide its tax treatment yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 訂正したメモと元の資料を、一緒に相談担当へお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please give the corrected note and the original documents together to the person handling your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約日と支払日を二行に分けて書き直しました。どの年に扱うかは担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二行の事実メモを用意して対象年の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've rewritten the reservation date and payment date on two separate lines. I'll ask the person in charge which year it should be treated as belonging to.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare a two-line note of the facts and ask to check the applicable year. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 日付の事実を分けた資料でおつなぎします。ご相談ありがとうございました。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll refer you with the documents distinguishing the facts about the dates. Thank you for your inquiry. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行の案内をご覧ですか。今は次の案内をお待ちいただいています。
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the service information? We're currently asking passengers to wait for the next announcement.

DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 画面では山頂が晴れているので、すぐ乗れると思いました。今の映像ではないのですか。
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 画面の晴天を現在の映像と思ったことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-02.translation: The screen shows sunshine at the summit, so I thought we could board right away. Is that not a live picture?
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the sunny scene on the screen for a live image. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この画面は紹介用の録画です。現在の運行状況は隣の掲示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-03.translation: This screen is playing a promotional recording. Please check the notice beside it for the current service status.

DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 録画だったのですね。掲示には「調整中」とありますが、出発時刻はまだ決まっていないということですか。
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 録画と調整中の掲示を区別して出発時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it was a recording. The notice says 'adjustments in progress.' Does that mean the departure time hasn't been decided yet?
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the recording from the adjustment notice and ask about the departure time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、まだ決まっていません。乗車券も案内が出てから販売します。
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. It hasn't been decided yet. We'll also start selling tickets after the announcement.

DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に買って順番を確保することはできないのですね。同行者にも、映像を見ただけで出発を約束しないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 販売前に順番を確保できないことを同行者へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-06.translation: So we can't buy tickets in advance to secure our place. I'll tell the others not to promise we'll be leaving just based on that video.
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your companions that you cannot secure a place before ticket sales begin. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次の案内を待たれるか、別の予定にされるかはお客様でお決めください。
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's up to you whether to wait for the next announcement or make other plans.

DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は帰る時間が決まっています。もう少しだけ待ち、時刻が決まらなければ山頂へ行く予定を変えます。
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰宅時刻を踏まえて待つ時間を自分で区切る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-08.translation: We have a fixed time to head home today. We'll wait just a little longer, and if the time still isn't decided, we'll change our plan to visit the summit.
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Set your own limit on how long to wait, taking your time to head home into account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 待つ場合はこちらの待合でお願いします。新しい案内が出たらお知らせします。
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you're waiting, please use this waiting area. We'll let you know when there's a new announcement.

DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待合で同行者と相談します。録画の天気と現在の運行を分けて考えます。
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待合で相談し現在の運行案内を確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll discuss it with the others in the waiting area. I'll treat the weather in the recording and the current service status as separate things.
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will discuss it in the waiting area and check the current service information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。待合へお進みください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-YMN-OTSUKI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please go to the waiting area. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その望遠鏡をご利用になる前に、少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please wait a moment before using that telescope.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 台に置いてあるので、展望台の備品だと思いました。利用料を払えば使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 置かれた望遠鏡を共用と思い利用条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Since it's on a stand, I thought it belonged to the observation deck. Can I use it if I pay a fee?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the telescope was for shared use and ask about the conditions for using it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そちらは別のお客様がお持ちになった物です。施設では貸し出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That belongs to another visitor who brought it here. We don't lend it out.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持ち主の物だったのですね。のぞく向きを変えようとしましたが、触らず離れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 個人の所有物と理解し触らず離れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it belongs to someone. I was about to change the direction it points, but I'll step away without touching it.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that it is private property and say you will step away without touching it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。道具を使わずに景色を見るなら、こちらの案内板があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. If you'd like to enjoy the view without equipment, there's this information board.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の目で見える範囲を知りたいです。案内板の写真と、今見ている景色は同じ方向ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 裸眼で景色と案内写真の方向を比べたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to know what I can see with my own eyes. Is the photograph on the board facing the same direction as the view I'm looking at now?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to compare the direction of the view seen with the naked eye and the photograph on the board. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真は正面の景色を説明しています。雲に隠れている部分は、今日は見えないこともあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The photograph explains the view straight ahead. Parts hidden by clouds may not be visible today.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真にあるものを全部探そうとしなくてよいのですね。見えている尾根の形から比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 雲に隠れた部分を無理に探さず尾根を比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I don't have to try to find everything shown in the photograph. I'll compare the shapes of the ridges I can see.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare the ridges without trying too hard to find the parts hidden by clouds. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 足元を確かめ、通路を空けてご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please watch your footing and keep the walkway clear while you look.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この位置なら通路をふさぎません。人の道具を借りず、案内板で見比べてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路を空け自分で景色を楽しむ方法を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't block the walkway in this spot. I'll compare the view with the board without borrowing anyone's equipment.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a way to enjoy the view yourself while keeping the walkway clear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その場所でご覧いただけます。それでは、景色をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, you can look from there. Enjoy the view.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 扉の正面を少し空けていただけますか。降りる方がいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you leave a little space in front of the doors? People are getting off.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乗る位置の印で待っていました。ここにいると、降りる方の通り道になるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗車位置の印と降車客の通路が重なることを理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was waiting at the boarding-position mark. Standing here puts me in the path of people getting off, doesn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the boarding mark overlaps with the route used by people getting off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。今は扉の脇へ寄り、降りる方が通ってから乗ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. For now, please move beside the doors and board after the people getting off have passed.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 脇へ移動します。ただ、同行者にはこの印の前で会うと伝えてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 脇へ移るが同行者との約束場所が変わると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll move to the side. But I've told the person I'm with to meet me in front of this mark.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will move aside but that this changes the meeting place agreed with your companion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 合流を待つ間も、扉の前は空けておきましょう。同行者へ場所の変更を連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please keep the space in front of the doors clear while you wait to meet up, too. Can you let your companion know about the change?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 柱のそばに移ったと送ります。離れた所から急いで来ても、降りる方の間を抜けないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新しい合流場所と降車客を優先することを連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll message them that I've moved beside the pillar. I'll also tell them not to weave through people getting off, even if they're hurrying from farther away.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your companion the new meeting place and that people getting off have priority. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同行者が来る前に発車の案内があったら、無理に乗らず次の案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: If a departure is announced before your companion arrives, don't force your way aboard. Please check the next announcement.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私だけ先に乗るのはやめます。合流できなければ二人ともホームに残ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 合流できないときは先に乗らずホームに残ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't board ahead of them on my own. If we can't meet up, we'll both stay on the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to stay on the platform rather than board first if you cannot meet up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでお願いします。降りる方が通りましたので、周囲を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do that. The people getting off have now passed, so please check your surroundings.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同行者もここに来ました。二人で足元を見て、空いた扉から乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合流と降車完了を確認して一緒に乗ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: My companion has arrived here, too. We'll both watch our step and board through the now-clear doorway.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you have met up and that everyone has finished getting off, and say you will board together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 合流できましたね。慌てずお乗りください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've met up now. Please board without rushing. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほど届けてくださった定期入れのことでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the pass holder you handed in earlier?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一緒にいた友人から、持ち主を名乗る人が私に返してほしいと言っていると連絡が来ました。でも、品物はもうこちらに渡してあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 届け済みの品を返してほしいという伝言を受けたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A friend who was with me contacted me to say someone claiming to be the owner wants me to give it back. But I've already handed the item over here.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report receiving a message asking you to return an item you have already handed in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様が取り戻して直接渡す必要はありません。この窓口で対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You don't need to take it back and hand it over yourself. We'll deal with it at this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、私が品物を預かっているとは答えません。友人を通して、何と案内すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分が保管中と誤解させず案内方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I won't say I'm holding the item. What should I tell the person through my friend?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how to direct the person without giving the impression you still have the item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらへ届けたことと、窓口で確認を受ける必要があることをお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell them you've handed it in here and that they need to have it verified at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 届出先を伝えます。伝言だけでは持ち主か確かめられないので、私から品物の中身を詳しく話すのも控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 届出先を伝え中身の詳細は伝言で明かさないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell them where I handed it in. Since I can't verify ownership through a relayed message alone, I'll also avoid describing the contents in detail myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will tell them where the item was handed in without revealing details of its contents through messages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その対応で結構です。拾った場所などは、先ほど伺った記録を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's fine. We'll use the information we recorded earlier about where you found it and so on.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もう一度拾った場所へ戻って待つ必要もないのですね。これから仕事に向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 拾得場所で待たず仕事へ向かってよいか確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I don't need to go back to where I found it and wait there again, either. I'll head to work now.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check that you can head to work without waiting at the place where you found it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。追加の確認が必要な場合の連絡方法は、届出のときに伺っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's right. When you handed it in, we took your contact details in case we need to check anything further.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、友人には届出先だけ伝えてもらいます。窓口での確認はお任せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 届出先の案内を済ませ窓口の確認へ引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll ask my friend just to pass on where I handed it in. I'll leave the verification at the counter to you.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Finish directing the person to where you handed the item in and leave verification to the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございました。こちらで引き続き対応します。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. We'll continue handling it here. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの軽食と紙の応援飾りを一緒にお求めですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like both this snack and the paper cheering decoration?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。飾りは記念に持ち帰りたいので、ソースが付かないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記念の紙飾りをソースで汚したくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to take the decoration home as a souvenir, so I want to keep sauce off it.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you don't want sauce to stain the paper decoration you are keeping as a souvenir. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食品は食品用の袋に入れます。飾りは長く、同じ袋には収まりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll put the food in a food bag. The decoration is long and won't fit in the same bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 折り曲げずに持ちたいです。軽食と一緒に押し込まず、飾りは手に持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 飾りを折らず食品袋とは別に手持ちすると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to carry it without bending it. I won't squeeze it in with the snack; I'll carry the decoration in my hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to carry the decoration by hand separately from the food bag without bending it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お飲物もありますが、全部をお一人で運べそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: There's a drink, too. Do you think you can carry everything yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 両手がふさがりますね。席にいる同行者に、飲物を取りに来てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲物まで持てないため同行者へ応援を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Both my hands will be full. I'll ask my companion at our seats to come and collect the drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask your companion to help because you cannot carry the drink as well. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの受取り口の脇でお待ちいただけます。通路は空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can wait beside the pickup counter here. Please keep the walkway clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 脇で待ちます。軽食の袋を地面へ置いて飾りを持ち替えるのは避けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路を空け食品を地面へ置かず待つと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait to the side. I'll avoid putting the snack bag on the ground to change how I'm holding the decoration.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait with the walkway clear and will not put the food on the ground. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同行者の方がいらっしゃいましたので、飲物をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your companion has arrived, so I'll hand over the drink.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 飲物は同行者、軽食と飾りは私が持ちます。食品の袋を飾りに重ねず運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食品と飾りを重ねない運搬分担を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: My companion will carry the drink, and I'll carry the snack and decoration. We'll carry them without putting the food bag on top of the decoration.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm how you will share the carrying without stacking the food and decoration together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分担できましたね。それでは、試合をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've worked out who'll carry what. Enjoy the game.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察前に確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you'd like to check before your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 口元のことで相談したいのですが、待っている方に聞こえる所では詳しく話しづらいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 他の客の前で口元の悩みを詳しく話しづらいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to discuss a concern around my mouth, but it's hard to go into detail where the people waiting can hear me.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that it is difficult to discuss your concern around your mouth in detail in front of other patients. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付ではご用件だけで結構です。詳しい相談は診察室で担当者へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: At reception, you only need to tell us what you're here for. Please discuss the details with the person seeing you in the consultation room.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 診察のときに相談したいことがある、とだけ伝えます。言葉が出なくなりそうなのでメモを見せてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付への簡潔な用件と診察時のメモ使用を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll just say there's something I'd like to discuss during the consultation. I may struggle to get the words out, so may I show them a note?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Discuss briefly stating your purpose at reception and using a note during the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: メモを持参されていることを担当者に伝えます。内容は診察時にご自身でお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the person seeing you that you've brought a note. Please show them the contents yourself during the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受付へメモを預けず、自分で持っておきます。鏡で気になる場所を説明したいことも書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: メモを自分で保管し説明したい場所も書いたと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll keep the note with me rather than leave it at reception. I've also written that I'd like to use a mirror to explain which area concerns me.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the note yourself and have written down which area you want to explain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 順番になりましたらお呼びします。今ここで説明を練習する必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll call you when it's your turn. You don't need to practice explaining it here now.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら落ち着いて待てます。誰かが近くにいる間は、メモを開いたままにしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 周囲に内容が見えないようにして順番を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I can wait calmly. While anyone is nearby, I won't leave the note open.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait for your turn while keeping the contents hidden from those around you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診察室へご案内します。メモも一緒にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll show you to the consultation room. Please bring your note with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持って行きます。まずメモがあることを伝え、担当者に読んでもらってから話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 診察室でメモを示してから相談を始めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll bring it. I'll first explain that I have a note, then speak after the person seeing me has read it.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show your note in the consultation room before starting the discussion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、そのようにお伝えください。それでは、こちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please explain it that way. This way, please.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次の見学場所へ進みますが、お連れの方も移動されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: We're moving on to the next viewing area. Will the person with you be moving on, too?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父がこの説明をまだ読んでいます。読んでいる途中なので、団体のみなさんを待たせてしまいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行の父が説明を読み終えておらず団体を待たせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My father is still reading this explanation. He's partway through, so we may end up holding up the whole group.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your father has not finished reading the explanation and may keep the group waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 団体は予定どおり進みます。ご家族でこの場所をご覧になることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The group will move on as scheduled. You can also stay here and look around as a family.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 父を急がせて連れて行くより、ここで一緒に読みたいです。団体から離れる場合は、お知らせすればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 父を急がせず家族で見学するため離脱方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd rather stay and read it with my father than rush him along. If we leave the group, should I let you know?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how to leave the group so you can look around as a family without rushing your father. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 途中で離れる場合は、私にお知らせください。離れた後の再合流はできませんので、ご家族で見学を続けていただくことになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me if you're leaving partway through. You won't be able to rejoin afterward, so you'll need to continue looking around as a family.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、私と父はここから家族で見学します。ガイドが次の場所で待っているとは父に言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族で離脱し団体との後の合流を約束しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then my father and I will continue on our own as a family from here. I won't tell him the guide will be waiting at the next stop.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will leave as a family and will not promise to rejoin the group later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お二人の変更を確認しました。この後の見学は案内板の経路をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've noted the change for both of you. Please follow the route on the information boards for the rest of your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。説明を読み終えてから、父と次に見る場所を決めます。団体の速さに合わせて走るのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 読み終えてから経路を決め団体を走って追わないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Once we've finished reading, I'll decide with my father where to look next. We won't run to keep up with the group.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will decide the route after finishing reading and will not run to catch the group. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 団体の説明はここまでになります。お忘れ物がないか確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the end of the group commentary for you. Please check that you haven't left any belongings behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分たちの荷物を持っています。ここまで案内してくださり、ありがとうございました。父とゆっくり見学を続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物を確認してガイドへ感謝し家族見学へ切り替える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: We have our belongings. Thank you for showing us around so far. I'll continue looking around at a relaxed pace with my father.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check your belongings, thank the guide, and switch to a family visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらこそ、ご参加ありがとうございました。それでは、お二人で見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for joining us. Enjoy the rest of your visit together.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みについて、どの点を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to check about the transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知人に借りたお金を分けて返したいです。窓口から、毎月いくらならよいか相手に聞いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 分割返済額について窓口に相手との交渉を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to repay money I borrowed from an acquaintance in installments. Could the bank counter ask them what monthly amount would be acceptable?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the counter to negotiate an installment repayment amount with the other person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでは、返済条件についてお相手と交渉することはできません。振込手続きについてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can't negotiate repayment terms with the other person on your behalf. We can explain the transfer procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 金額の合意は自分で取るのですね。相手が了承する前に、私の決めた額を送れば合意になると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の振込が相手の条件了承を意味すると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I have to get their agreement on the amount myself. I thought sending the amount I decided on before they agreed would establish an agreement.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought making a transfer yourself meant the other person accepted the terms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 振込手続きと、相手が返済条件を了承することは別です。未確定の条件はこちらで確定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Making a transfer and the other person accepting repayment terms are separate matters. We cannot finalize terms that are still undecided.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は金額を決めて送るのを保留します。相手と話すため、振込に必要な情報だけ整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 送金を保留し手続きに必要な情報の整理を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll hold off on deciding an amount and sending it today. I'd just like to organize the information needed for a transfer so I can talk to the other person.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put the transfer on hold and ask to organize the information needed for the procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 振込先や手続き方法などはご案内できます。ご相談内容を相手に送ることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can explain the destination account details, procedures, and so on. We will not pass the contents of your consultation on to the other person.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 個人的な相談を銀行から連絡してもらわず、自分で説明します。振込先の情報も本人から確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 私的な話合いと相手の振込先確認を自分で行う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll explain my personal situation myself rather than ask the bank to contact them about it. I'll also confirm their account details directly with them.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Handle the private discussion and confirmation of the other person's account details yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 条件が決まってから、改めて手続きの相談をしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've agreed on the terms, please consult us about the procedure again.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に返済の話合いをします。振込ができることと、条件が了承されたことを混同しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返済合意後に手続きし銀行の案内と合意を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll discuss the repayment first. I'll be careful not to confuse being able to make a transfer with having the terms accepted.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Arrange the transfer after agreeing on repayment and distinguish the bank's guidance from the agreement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本日の手続きは進めず、ご案内までとします。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-OTSUKI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We won't proceed with a transaction today; we'll just provide information. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。切符について、何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with a ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 港の近くで仕事の面接があります。室蘭駅から切符を買いたいんですが、港に近い駅を選べばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 港近くの仕事の面接に向かうと伝え、港に近い駅への切符を買えばよいか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a job interview near the port. I'd like to buy a ticket from Muroran Station. Should I just choose a station near the port?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are going to a job interview near the port and ask whether to buy a ticket to a station near the port. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 港といっても目的の場所が広いので、面接先の住所を確認しましょう。会社から案内は届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The port covers a large area, so let's check the interview address. Have you received directions from the company?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社名だけメモしましたが、メールを見ると受付の住所が別にあります。会社の本社ではなく、この受付へ行くようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社のメールには本社とは別の受付住所があると示し、そちらが行き先だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only noted down the company name, but looking at the email, there's a separate reception address. It seems I should go to that reception rather than the company's head office.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that the company's email lists a reception address separate from its head office and explain that this is your destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その受付の住所を基準に行き方を調べましょう。駅で降りた後の移動も含めて確認する必要があります。集合時刻は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's use that reception address to work out how to get there. We'll need to check the journey after you leave the station, too. Have they set a meeting time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 面接は午後二時です。駅から歩く時間を考えていませんでした。駅に着いたら終わりと思わず、受付までの経路を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 集合時刻を示し、駅で降りた後に受付まで歩く時間と道も確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The interview is at two in the afternoon. I hadn't considered the walking time from the station. I'd like to check the route all the way to reception rather than think arriving at the station is the end of the journey.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the meeting time and say you also want to check the route and walking time to reception after getting off at the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。目的地、降りる駅、その先の経路を確認してから切符を選びましょう。案内でわからない入口は、面接先へ尋ねると確実です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Let's confirm the destination, the station to get off at, and the route from there before choosing a ticket. If the directions don't make the entrance clear, asking the interview location is the reliable way to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 面接先にも入口を確認します。帰りは同僚に送ってもらうかもしれないので、今日は片道だけ買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 面接先に入口を確認すると伝え、帰りは送ってもらう可能性があるので片道券だけを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check the entrance with the interview location, too. A colleague may give me a lift back, so I'd like to buy just a one-way ticket today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check the entrance with the interview location and request only a one-way ticket because you may get a lift back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 片道のご希望ですね。区間が決まったら、購入できる方法と料金をご案内します。券売機で迷ったら操作前にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: A one-way ticket, then. Once we've established the route section, I'll explain the fares and available ways to buy it. If you're unsure at the ticket machine, please ask before using it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付住所と降車後の経路を先に確かめ、余裕のある移動を選びます。区間と料金を確認してから片道券を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付住所と降車後の経路を確かめて余裕のある移動を選び、区間と料金を確認して片道券を買うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first check the reception address and the route after getting off, then choose a journey that allows enough time. I'll buy a one-way ticket after confirming the route section and fare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the reception address and onward route, choose a journey with enough time, and buy a one-way ticket after confirming the route section and fare. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まずメールの受付住所をお示しください。行き方と購入方法を順に確認しましょう。お気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please show me the reception address in the email first. Let's check the route and how to buy your ticket in order. Have a safe journey.
